# #1778: Patch: the AI tries an X card at its biggest X, an Embiggened price, an Equip and a face-down set before a second lane of its cheapest play
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On a big turn the AI looks at only a short list of moves for each card in its hand, and today that list fills up with the same cheap play in different spots before anything else. A card that costs X (pay any amount, get that much effect) is only ever tried at its smallest amounts. A card's other ways of being played, such as its upgraded price, equipping it to a unit or setting it face down, are often never tried at all. So with 6 mana and Buff Billy, which grows with every mana spent, the AI plays it small beside a 2-drop instead of all in as an 18/18. Once built, each card's first tries cover its different ways of being played, biggest X first, before repeating one of them in another lane.

## Why
- The search keeps 20 moves at the root and 6 at each later step (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:40-41`, `root_branching` and `branching`), cut at `crates/ai/src/search.rs:111` (`moves.truncate(width)`). The shipped order is the heuristic one (`AI_MOVE_ORDER = MoveOrder::Heuristic`, `config.rs:551`).
- `round_robin` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, around 413-460) deals every card its first variant, then every card its second, and keeps each card's variants in the engine's listing order. `enemy_first` only interleaves them by aim.
- The engine lists a card's plays price outermost, lowest first:
  - `legal_x_values`: "every X `why_x_refused` passes, lowest first" (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:732`), then `for x in &x_values { for embiggen in &embiggens` (around 2057).
  - The Embiggened price comes second (`vec![false, true]`).
  - Equip plays come after every plain lane ("the plain zones first, then the Equip host zones after them").
  - A face-down set comes last (`out.extend(face_down_play_actions(…))`).
- The lane variants that crowd the rest out are often worth nothing to the search. Its duplicate check leaves a unit's lane out (`crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, around 833-835: "A unit's lane is left out, so the two lanes `candidate_actions` keeps for one play stay one position"), so several of a card's slots collapse into one position.
- On the AI's dealt-deck measure (`DEALT_Q`, `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs`, around 755-773, mean 0.6685 over 261 cards), Adaptive UI (`core-074`, an X spell) reads 0.5815, 75th lowest. The Meditative+ tests (`crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`, around 255-344) check only that a dearer price is a candidate at all, not that it survives the cut.

## Proposal
In `round_robin`, split each source's variants into ways of being played, keyed by `x`, `embiggen`, equip host or not, face-down or not, and the Tribute set:
- Each way gets its first variant before any way gets a second lane or target.
- The ways are taken dearest price first, then cheapest, then the rest, and Tribute sets go cheapest units first.
- `enemy_first` keeps working inside each way.

The beam's widths and the node budget are unchanged.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` (`round_robin`)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs` (or `meditative_plus.rs`)
- `crates/ai/README.md`, and the move-order paragraph of `docs/polish/3-ai.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On a hand wide enough to fill the root, `root_expansion` at `AI_BUDGET.root_branching` holds Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) at `x == mana`, an Embiggened play and a Cloaked card's face-down set.
- [ ] `decide` with 6 mana, Buff Billy and three 2-drops plays Billy at X=6.
- [ ] The B18 lethal puzzles and every `crates/ai` test stay green, and `cargo jackioh gate` passes, its performance probes included.
- [ ] The pull request reports an improve-dev arena screen against the parent (400 paired games), and `stats` before and after for `classicplus-069` and `core-074`.

## Size and risks
Hard, since it is the AI: about 80 lines in one function and about 200 lines of tests.
- The greedy baseline breaks exact ties by this list (`crates/ai/src/baselines.rs:52`), so its play shifts slightly. #1062 is the precedent, or greedy can keep a frozen order.
- Bigger X plays mean more draws and Buffs later in a line, so watch decision time on the perf gate's pinned positions.
- It touches the same move order as #1759, which is in flight, so build it after that.

# Plan: #1778 AI plays X at biggest X, Embiggen, Equip and face-down before second lane

## Goal

Ensure the AI considers a card's distinct ways of being played (highest and lowest X values, Embiggened price, Equip host play, face-down set, and cheapest Tribute combinations) before exhausting multiple lane placements of its cheapest play. In `round_robin` in [crates/ai/src/candidates.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs), each source's variants are partitioned into ways of being played keyed by `x`, `embiggen`, equip host, face-down, and Tribute set, with ways sorted dearest price first, then cheapest, then intermediate prices descending, and Tribute sets cheapest units first, keeping `enemy_first` active inside each way. This allows Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) at `x == mana`, an Embiggened play, and a Cloaked face-down set to survive the `root_branching` cut (20 moves) on a wide hand, and leads `decide` with 6 mana and Buff Billy to play Billy at X=6.

## Files to touch

| Path | Status | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| [`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs) | change | Define `WayKey`, `way_key`, `way_price`, `tribute_set_cost`; in `round_robin`, partition source variants by `WayKey`, sort ways dearest first, cheapest second, remaining descending, Tribute sets cheapest units first, apply `enemy_first` within each way, and round-robin across ways before assembling `source.variants`. |
| [`crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs) | change | Add unit tests in a new test module verifying that wide hands retain Buff Billy at `x == mana`, an Embiggened play, and a Cloaked face-down set in `root_expansion`, and that `decide` with 6 mana, Buff Billy, and three 2-drops plays Billy at X=6. |
| [`crates/ai/README.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/README.md) | change | Document in the search candidates section that variants are partitioned into ways of being played (X prices, Embiggen, Equip, face-down, and Tribute sets) before interleaving lanes. |
| [`docs/polish/3-ai.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/docs/polish/3-ai.md) | change | In the Tier 2 move-order summary (around line 530), document that variants within a source are grouped into ways of being played (dearest price first, cheapest second, Tribute sets cheapest units first) before interleaving. |

Must not touch: `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/server/`, `apps/web/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
Governed by SPEC §9.9 (Computer opponent), SPEC §10.2 (Legal moves), and R1062 (enemy targets first).

## Steps

1. **Define `WayKey` and extractor in [`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs)**
   Directly above `round_robin`, define `WayKey`:
   ```rust
   #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
   struct WayKey {
       x: Option<i32>,
       embiggen: Option<bool>,
       equip: bool,
       face_down: bool,
       tributes: Option<Vec<String>>,
       ability: Option<String>,
   }
   ```
   Add helper `fn way_key(action: &ActionBody) -> WayKey`:
   - For `ActionBody::Play { x, embiggen, equip, face_down, tributes, .. }`:
     - `x: *x`
     - `embiggen: *embiggen`
     - `equip: *equip == Some(true)`
     - `face_down: face_down.is_some()`
     - `tributes`: `tributes.as_ref().map(|t| { let mut s = t.clone(); s.sort(); s })`
     - `ability: None`
   - For `ActionBody::Activate { ability, tributes, .. }`:
     - `x: None`, `embiggen: None`, `equip: false`, `face_down: false`
     - `tributes`: `tributes.as_ref().map(|t| { let mut s = t.clone(); s.sort(); s })`
     - `ability: ability.clone()`
   - For `ActionBody::ActivatePower { .. }` and other actions: default/empty fields.

2. **Add `way_price` helper in [`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs)**
   Add `fn way_price(state: &GameState, action: &ActionBody) -> i32`:
   - For `ActionBody::Play { instance_id, x, embiggen, face_down, .. }`:
     Look up `card = find_instance(state, instance_id)`.
     Construct a probe `CardInstance` (following the pattern in [`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:2059-2064`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs#L2059-L2064)):
     ```rust
     let probe = CardInstance {
         x: x.or(card.x),
         embiggened: *embiggen,
         set_as: face_down.map(|reveal| jackioh_engine::state::SetAs {
             reveal,
             set_turn: state.turn,
             echo: None,
             revealing: None,
         }),
         ..card.clone()
     };
     effective_cost(state, &probe, CostOptions { as_play: Some(true) })
     ```
   - For `ActionBody::Activate` or `ActionBody::ActivatePower`: call `source_cost(state, action)`.
   - Default: `0`.

3. **Add `tribute_set_cost` helper in [`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs)**
   Add `fn tribute_set_cost(state: &GameState, tributes: Option<&[String]>) -> (i32, Vec<i32>)`:
   - If `None`, return `(0, Vec::new())`.
   - If `Some(ids)`:
     For each `id` in `ids`, look up `find_instance(state, id)`. Compute `effective_cost(state, card, CostOptions::default())`.
     Sort the unit costs ascending.
     Return `(costs.iter().sum(), costs)`.

4. **Update `round_robin` in [`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/src/candidates.rs)**
   In `round_robin`:
   Keep the initial grouping into `sources: Vec<Source>` by `source_id(action)`.
   Replace `source.variants = enemy_first(state, seat, std::mem::take(&mut source.variants));` with way partitioning and interleaving:
   - For each source:
     - Group `source.variants` into `IndexMap<WayKey, Vec<ActionBody>>`, tracking the first-seen index of each way to preserve `legal_actions` tie-breaking.
     - For each way group:
       - Run `enemy_first(state, seat, variants)` on its variant list.
       - Read `price = way_price(state, &variants[0])`.
       - Read `tribute_cost = tribute_set_cost(state, key.tributes.as_deref())`.
     - Find `max_price` and `min_price` across all ways of this source.
     - Assign each way a price rank:
       - `rank = 0` if `price == max_price` (dearest price first).
       - `rank = 1` if `price == min_price` (cheapest price second).
       - `rank = 2` otherwise (the rest).
     - Sort ways by:
       1. `a.rank.cmp(&b.rank)`
       2. if `a.rank == 2`: `b.price.cmp(&a.price)` (intermediate prices descending)
       3. `a.tribute_cost.cmp(&b.tribute_cost)` (cheapest units first)
       4. `a.first_seen_idx.cmp(&b.first_seen_idx)` (ties preserve legal_actions order)
     - Interleave variants across the ordered ways:
       ```rust
       let rounds = ways.iter().map(|w| w.variants.len()).max().unwrap_or(0);
       let mut assembled = Vec::new();
       for round in 0..rounds {
           for way in &ways {
               if let Some(variant) = way.variants.get(round) {
                   assembled.push(variant.clone());
               }
           }
       }
       source.variants = assembled;
       ```
   - Keep the outer source-level round-robin across sources unchanged: sort sources by `source.cost` descending (ties keep index), and round-robin across sources.

5. **Add tests in [`crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs)**
   Add a test module `mod ways_of_being_played`:
   - `buff_billy_embiggen_and_cloaked_set_survive_root_expansion`:
     Create a scenario at 6 mana crystals with P1 hand having 10 cards (hand limit, filling root width):
     `["classicplus-069", "core-084", "classic-006", "core-008", "core-011", "core-017", "core-005", "core-020", "core-025", "core-035"]`.
     Call `root_expansion(&state, AI, AI_BUDGET.root_branching, MoveOrder::Heuristic, &POLICY_PRIOR)`.
     Assert that `root_expansion` contains:
     - Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) with `x == Some(6)` (`x == mana`).
     - Going Long (`core-084`) with `embiggen == Some(true)`.
     - Cloaked Toe Cracker (`classic-006`) with `face_down.is_some()`.
   - `decide_with_six_mana_and_buff_billy_plays_billy_at_x_six`:
     Create a scenario at 6 mana crystals with P1 hand having Buff Billy and three 2-drops:
     `["classicplus-069", "core-011", "core-008", "core-017"]`.
     Call `decide(&state, AI, &mut ai_options("billy-x6", AI_BUDGET))`.
     Assert that the decision plays Buff Billy at `x == Some(6)`.
   - `tribute_sets_prefer_cheaper_units`:
     Create a scenario with a Tribute card and units of differing costs on field (e.g. 1-cost vs 3-cost unit).
     Assert that in candidate actions for the Tribute card, the variant tributing the 1-cost unit appears before the variant tributing the 3-cost unit.

6. **Update docs**
   - In [`crates/ai/README.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/README.md) under Section 2 (`decide reads only redact`), update the candidates sentence to note that each source's variants are partitioned into ways of being played (X values, Embiggen, Equip, face-down, and Tribute sets) before multiple lane variants of one play are repeated.
   - In [`docs/polish/3-ai.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/docs/polish/3-ai.md) under Section 3.1 Tier 2 (`candidates.ts (B1)`), update the tier 2 move order description to note that within each source, variants are partitioned into ways of being played (dearest price first, then cheapest, then remaining descending, Tribute sets cheapest units first) and interleaved, with `enemy_first` applied inside each way.

## Tests

- [`crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-1778/crates/ai/tests/ai/search.rs):
  - `ways_of_being_played::buff_billy_embiggen_and_cloaked_set_survive_root_expansion`: verifies Buff Billy at X=6, Embiggened play, and Cloaked face-down play all appear within the first 20 candidates of `root_expansion` on a wide 10-card hand.
  - `ways_of_being_played::decide_with_six_mana_and_buff_billy_plays_billy_at_x_six`: verifies `decide` with 6 mana, Buff Billy, and three 2-drops chooses Billy at X=6.
  - `ways_of_being_played::tribute_sets_prefer_cheaper_units`: verifies that sacrificing a cheaper unit precedes sacrificing an expensive unit for the same Tribute play.
- Commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai search::ways_of_being_played`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai tactics_b18`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`
  - `cargo jackioh gate`

## Done when

- [ ] `root_expansion` at `AI_BUDGET.root_branching` on a 10-card hand holds Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) at `x == mana`, an Embiggened play, and a Cloaked card's face-down set.
- [ ] `decide` with 6 mana, Buff Billy, and three 2-drops plays Billy at X=6.
- [ ] Tribute choices order combinations with cheaper sacrificed units first.
- [ ] B18 lethal puzzles pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai tactics_b18`.
- [ ] All `jackioh-ai` crate tests pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes with clean games and performance probes intact.
- [ ] Pull request reports improve-dev arena screen against parent (400 paired games) and `stats` comparison for `classicplus-069` and `core-074`.

## Risks

- **Greedy baseline tie-breaking**: The greedy baseline breaks simulation score ties by the order in `candidate_actions`. Reordering variants shifts greedy choices when two actions evaluate identically (#1062 precedent). Verified by passing `cargo jackioh gate` (including `ai-vs-greedy`).
- **Performance & Branching**: Exploring higher X values creates larger board states in simulations earlier in the candidate list. Bounded by existing search budgets (`nodes = 600`, `branching = 6`) and verified by `cargo jackioh gate`'s performance probes on pinned positions.
- **Purity & Determinism**: Uses deterministic sorting with `IndexMap` and insertion/discovery order tie-breakers, preserving bit-for-bit repeatability across platforms and WebAssembly (CLAUDE.md rule 4).

## Open questions

None. The requirements, sorting order, and tie-breaking invariants are fully specified by the issue and engine contracts.
